text: The package read the bait AWS credentials file at /home/dev/.aws/credentials and then attempted requests carrying that key to api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, sts.us-east-1.amazonaws.com and the 169.254.169.254 metadata endpoint, spawning curl and a shell script to do it; it also tried to query gcloud configuration. This is credential-harvesting behaviour that closely resembles the Shai-Hulud worm, and in a real environment the same code would hand live cloud and registry tokens to an outside party. Do not merge this dependency: block it, and if it has already run anywhere with real credentials, rotate the affected AWS, GitHub and npm tokens and check those accounts for unauthorized use.
